description: E1: Orrik's armour and the Skarn's chain-iron beaten again for the giant who broke them - a horned helm, the trophy spaulders, a chain-bound harness, the coil's vambraces, greaves, the Heir's Torc. It is made for a colossus the Skarn tried to chain: what binds the giant who wears it strains off him sooner. Harrok's Oath-ring, given at the Stone Throne when he holds the Moot, is its other trinket.

bonuses.name: Chain-breaker
bonuses.text: Chains on you strain off 40% faster (pulling and heaving)

bonuses.name: Unbound
bonuses.text: Chains strain off you half as fast again: a single heave tears any chain, at any stage
